scenes.vo: Last night, I found Nora's rules. Her last line said it learned her voice.
On the third night, I didn't even pretend to sleep. At three AM exactly, three slow knocks.
Then a girl's voice. Weak. Crying. Please, I used to live here. I'm NORA. Help me.
She said it was right behind her. She begged me to open the door. My fingers were already on the CHAIN.
Then I remembered rule three. The peephole wasn't dark. So I LOOKED. A girl in a white nightgown stood at the end of the hall.
She walked closer, slowly, until she filled the glass. Where her face should have been, there was only a PEEPHOLE.
